markscheme.html:
A

The graph shows four thermodynamic processes. Process C is isochoric (constant volume) and D is isobaric (constant pressure). Processes A and B are represented by curves. On a pressure-volume (p-V) diagram, an adiabatic process (PV^γ = constant) is represented by a steeper curve than an isothermal process (PV = constant). Comparing the two curved paths, A is visibly steeper than B. Therefore, A represents the adiabatic process.

question.html:
Which part of the graph represents an adiabatic process?

  1. A
  2. B
  3. C
  4. D
